contexts.text: The infants (there) are sent by the Lord to infants (here).
It is said of the Lord that He was sent by the Father, as also here, Jehovah hath sent us (), and everywhere by sent, is signified to go out. Illustrated.
So it is said of the Holy Spirit that it is sent, that is, that it goes out from the Divine of the Lord. Illustrated.
As all Divine truth goes out from Divine good, the term sent is properly predicated of Divine truth.
He that is sent puts on the person of the sender...
They sent Rebekah () = separation from the affection of Divine truth. To send = to be separated.
That the Father sent Him = that He proceeds from the Father.
Anyone (there) can easily be let into the state of life which he had (here). AC 4659:2.
I would have sent thee in gladness... () = ... that it separated itself in freedom...
Let me go () = that temptation ceased. AC 4284. (Compare AC 4290.)
I will send thee unto them () = that he should teach Divine spiritual goods... To send = to go out and proceed, and also at the same time to teach. Illustrated.
When (the celestial Angels) are sent to others...
Man is then let into the state of evil in which he is... AC 6657:2.
Man is let into a state of temptation.
Send you your other brother () = that he may give the good of faith.
To his father he sent... () = given gratis to spiritual good.
He sent Judah before him () = a communication of the good of the Church.
The Divine Human is called an Angel, because by an Angel is meant one sent, and the Lord as to the Divine Human is called sent.
To be sent = to proceed; and sent is Angel. That the Lord calls Himself sent. Illustrated.
I will send thee unto Pharaoh () = the Holy which proceeds from the Lord's Human...
He will let you go () = the driving away of those in falsities, and the deliverance of those in truths. To let go = to be driven away.
Send by the hand Thou wilt send () = that the Divine truth... should be uttered mediately... To send, when said of the Lord, = to proceed. AC 7059. AC 7166.
With a strong hand he shall let them go () = that they shall flee from them... Explained.
That he let the sons of Israel go () = that they go away and leave them. AC 7271. AC 7305. AC 7312. AC 7349. AC 7439. AC 7540.
I will send all My plagues () = that all the coming evils should rush together upon them... To send = to rush in.
I will send the Spirit of Truth to you = to go and proceed.
A sending, occurs.
I send an Angel before thee () = the Lord as to the Divine Human. To send, when said of the Lord, = to proceed. AC 10528.

To send with them, when by Jehovah, () = the Divine leading, and also the Divine proceeding. Therefore Angels are so called from being sent; and therefore the Lord so frequently said that He was sent by the Father, by which is signified the Divine proceeding. AR 344:end. TCR 92:2, Illustrated.
They at once commit them to life.

That he was sent by the Father into the world means that He was conceived from Jehovah as a Father... Unfold the passages where send and sent are mentioned, and you will see (that this is the meaning). Illustrated. ( = to take on Himself the Human. DLord 31:end.)
Sending by His Angel () = revealed by the Lord through Heaven. AE 8.
The sending of the Holy Spirit. Explained.
After death, man is let into both states.
They sent gifts one to another () = their consociation from love.
Those who have done the good of life... are not let into the evils of their will.
